sentence: The steps are as follows.
zh-TW: 步驟如下。

sentence: Please call the above number for help.
zh-TW: 如需協助，請撥打上述電話號碼。

sentence: To date, we've sold over a thousand copies.
zh-TW: 到目前為止，我們已經賣出一千多本。

sentence: I won't go into details right now.
zh-TW: 我現在先不談細節。
tagging_notes: go into 在此為「深入探討」

sentence: There are too many people here.
zh-TW: 這裡人太多了。

sentence: I met a lot of people in the course of my work.
zh-TW: 我在工作過程中認識了很多人。

sentence: I'm more or less ready to go.
zh-TW: 我差不多準備好可以走了。

sentence: I'm looking for a short-term rental.
zh-TW: 我在找短期租屋。
tagging_notes: 句中寫作 short-term

sentence: This book is aimed at beginners.
zh-TW: 這本書是針對初學者寫的。

sentence: My alarm didn't go off this morning.
zh-TW: 我的鬧鐘今天早上沒響。
tagging_notes: go off 在此為「（鬧鐘）響」

sentence: Take a jacket in case it gets cold.
zh-TW: 帶件外套，以防天氣變冷。

sentence: Be careful out there, the roads are icy.
zh-TW: 在外面要小心，路面結冰了。

sentence: The tour is led by a local guide.
zh-TW: 這趟導覽由當地導遊帶領。

sentence: More and more people work from home now.
zh-TW: 越來越多人現在在家工作。

sentence: Can I have a look at the menu?
zh-TW: 我可以看一下菜單嗎？

sentence: I believe in you.
zh-TW: 我相信你做得到。
tagging_notes: believe in 在此為「相信（某人的能力）」

sentence: To put it simply, we're out of money.
zh-TW: 簡單來說，我們沒錢了。
tagging_notes: put it 在此為「這麼說；表達」

sentence: These days, everyone pays by phone.
zh-TW: 現在大家都用手機付款。

sentence: Who's in charge here?
zh-TW: 這裡誰負責？

sentence: I don't feel like cooking tonight.
zh-TW: 我今晚不想煮飯。
tagging_notes: feel like 在此為「想要（做某事）」

sentence: You can stay up to the end of the month.
zh-TW: 你可以住到月底。
tagging_notes: up to 在此為「直到」

sentence: Have you heard of this band?
zh-TW: 你有聽說過這個樂團嗎？

sentence: Ten teams will take part in the contest.
zh-TW: 有十隊會參加這場比賽。

sentence: I'll help in so far as I can.
zh-TW: 我會盡我所能幫忙。

sentence: I have a part-time job at a bakery.
zh-TW: 我在一家麵包店打工。
tagging_notes: 句中寫作 part-time

sentence: I look forward to seeing you again.
zh-TW: 我很期待再見到你。

sentence: He's new, and as such, he needs some help.
zh-TW: 他是新人，因此需要一些幫助。
tagging_notes: as such 在此為「就此而言；因此」

sentence: It's bound to rain this weekend.
zh-TW: 這個週末肯定會下雨。

sentence: Could you turn on the light?
zh-TW: 你可以把燈打開嗎？

sentence: The new mall is set to open next month.
zh-TW: 新的購物中心預計下個月開幕。
tagging_notes: set to 在此為「即將」

sentence: Let's move on to the next topic.
zh-TW: 我們進入下一個主題吧。

sentence: In contrast to last year, sales are up.
zh-TW: 跟去年相比，銷售額上升了。

sentence: At this stage, nothing is decided.
zh-TW: 在這個階段，什麼都還沒決定。

sentence: The tickets are all but sold out.
zh-TW: 票幾乎都賣光了。

sentence: Above all, stay safe on the road.
zh-TW: 最重要的是，路上注意安全。

sentence: I need to get rid of these old clothes.
zh-TW: 我需要把這些舊衣服處理掉。

sentence: In any case, I'll call you tomorrow.
zh-TW: 無論如何，我明天會打給你。

sentence: Thanks to you, I passed the exam.
zh-TW: 多虧了你，我考試通過了。

sentence: Please go away, I'm busy.
zh-TW: 拜託走開，我在忙。

sentence: Could you say that once more?
zh-TW: 你可以再說一次嗎？

sentence: Oh well, maybe next time.
zh-TW: 噢好吧，也許下次吧。

sentence: I'll follow up with an email tomorrow.
zh-TW: 我明天會再寄封電子郵件跟進。

sentence: I would say it's about two hours away.
zh-TW: 我會說那裡大約兩小時車程。

sentence: The water was found to be safe.
zh-TW: 這水經檢驗是安全的。

sentence: I meant to text you, but I forgot.
zh-TW: 我本來要傳訊息給你，但我忘了。
tagging_notes: meant to 在此為「打算；本來要」

sentence: Hang on, I'll be right back.
zh-TW: 等一下，我馬上回來。
tagging_notes: hang on 在此為「稍等」

sentence: The rain turned into snow overnight.
zh-TW: 雨在一夜之間變成了雪。

sentence: There's something about this place I really like.
zh-TW: 這個地方有種我很喜歡的特質。

sentence: He should be home by now.
zh-TW: 他現在應該已經到家了。

sentence: Will it rain? I don't think so.
zh-TW: 會下雨嗎？我不這麼認為。

sentence: Go ahead, take a seat.
zh-TW: 請便，坐吧。
tagging_notes: go ahead 在此為「儘管做」

sentence: Small habits can bring about big changes.
zh-TW: 小習慣能帶來大改變。

sentence: We had better hurry, or we'll miss the bus.
zh-TW: 我們最好快一點，不然會趕不上公車。

sentence: Please dispose of waste in accordance with local rules.
zh-TW: 請依照當地規定處理垃圾。

sentence: We called on my aunt last Sunday.
zh-TW: 我們上週日去拜訪了我阿姨。
tagging_notes: call on 在此為「拜訪」

sentence: At times, the job can be stressful.
zh-TW: 有時候這份工作壓力會很大。

sentence: We walked all the way home.
zh-TW: 我們一路走回家。
tagging_notes: all the way 在此為「一路」

sentence: The new rule is now in effect.
zh-TW: 新規定現在已經生效。
tagging_notes: in effect 在此為「生效」

sentence: I can't afford to buy a car right now.
zh-TW: 我現在買不起車。

sentence: I lost sight of him in the crowd.
zh-TW: 我在人群中看不到他了。

sentence: Thanks for letting me know in advance.
zh-TW: 謝謝你提前告訴我。

sentence: It was a mistake on the part of the hotel.
zh-TW: 這是飯店方面的疏失。

sentence: Don't bring up work at dinner.
zh-TW: 吃晚餐時別提工作的事。
tagging_notes: bring up 在此為「提出（話題）」

sentence: Please take off your shoes at the door.
zh-TW: 請在門口脫鞋。
tagging_notes: take off 在此為「脫掉」

sentence: I left early so as to avoid the rush hour.
zh-TW: 我提早出門，以便避開尖峰時段。

sentence: Let's take advantage of the sale.
zh-TW: 我們趁特價好好買一下吧。

sentence: We're a little short of cash this month.
zh-TW: 我們這個月手頭有點緊。
tagging_notes: short of 在此為「缺乏」

sentence: Over the years, we've become close friends.
zh-TW: 這些年來，我們變成了很要好的朋友。

sentence: Don't forget to switch on the heater.
zh-TW: 別忘了打開暖氣。

sentence: It's by no means easy, but it's worth it.
zh-TW: 這絕不容易，但很值得。

sentence: I could hardly hear him on the phone.
zh-TW: 講電話時我幾乎聽不到他說話。

sentence: We need to come up with a better idea.
zh-TW: 我們需要想出更好的點子。

sentence: The person in question has already left.
zh-TW: 那位當事人已經離開了。
tagging_notes: in question 在此為「討論中的」

sentence: Why did you buy it in the first place?
zh-TW: 你當初為什麼要買它？
tagging_notes: in the first place 在此為「一開始；當初」

sentence: The hike proved to be harder than we thought.
zh-TW: 這趟健行結果比我們想的還難。

sentence: We have a lot in common.
zh-TW: 我們有很多共同點。

sentence: No matter what happens, call me.
zh-TW: 無論發生什麼事，都打給我。

sentence: At this point, we can't change the plan.
zh-TW: 到了這個時候，我們沒辦法改計畫了。

sentence: The trip in itself was worth the money.
zh-TW: 這趟旅行本身就值回票價了。

sentence: Between tea and coffee, I prefer the former.
zh-TW: 茶和咖啡之間，我比較喜歡前者。

sentence: If only I had more free time.
zh-TW: 要是我有更多空閒時間就好了。

sentence: I have yet to hear back from them.
zh-TW: 我還沒收到他們的回覆。

sentence: It's up to you where we eat.
zh-TW: 我們去哪裡吃由你決定。
tagging_notes: up to 在此為「取決於」

sentence: Bring snacks, drinks, or whatever you like.
zh-TW: 帶點零食、飲料，或你喜歡的東西都行。

sentence: Please hand over your phones before the test.
zh-TW: 考試前請交出手機。

sentence: In the light of the weather, the game was canceled.
zh-TW: 鑒於天氣狀況，比賽取消了。

sentence: Treat everyone in the same way.
zh-TW: 對每個人都要一視同仁。

sentence: I didn't know it would cost that much.
zh-TW: 我不知道會花那麼多錢。

sentence: It's hard to know the extent to which it helped.
zh-TW: 很難知道它幫助到什麼程度。

sentence: I haven't seen Tom for some time.
zh-TW: 我有一陣子沒見到 Tom 了。

sentence: I helped him move, and he bought me dinner in return.
zh-TW: 我幫他搬家，他請我吃晚餐作為回報。

sentence: I was scared to death.
zh-TW: 我嚇死了。
tagging_notes: to death 在此為「極度地」

sentence: He was excused on the grounds that he was sick.
zh-TW: 他以生病為由獲准缺席。

sentence: Oh dear, I spilled my coffee.
zh-TW: 哎呀，我把咖啡灑了。

sentence: The bill must be paid in full.
zh-TW: 帳單必須全額付清。

sentence: Is everyone on board? We're leaving.
zh-TW: 大家都上車了嗎？我們要出發了。
tagging_notes: on board 在此為「在車上」

sentence: To some extent, it was my fault.
zh-TW: 某種程度上，那是我的錯。

sentence: There must be some kind of mistake.
zh-TW: 一定是哪裡弄錯了。

sentence: Slow down, I can't keep up!
zh-TW: 慢一點，我跟不上了！
tagging_notes: keep up 在此為「跟上」

sentence: Where's my key? No idea.
zh-TW: 我的鑰匙在哪裡？不知道。
